items.title: Mutineer: Find Code Changes Your Tests Fail to Notice
items.blurb: Mutineer is a clean-room mutation-testing tool for Ruby. It mutates your source one change at a time, runs your suite against each mutant, and reports the gaps your tests fail to catch.
